notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Benilla's two selection sends: CMSG_SET_SELECTION (full 8-byte guid, 0 clears) and CMSG_INSPECT (full guid; reply unparsed). MSUI implements both as SendFullGuid one-liners (WorldSession.SetSelection/Inspect), wired to targeting (Program.Targeting.cs) and the inspect window (Program.Inspect.cs); MSUI additionally parses SMSG_INSPECT, which Benilla deliberately ignores.
